description: The two-value forgetting formula is true under a valuation exactly when changing the forgotten atom to one of the two Boolean values makes the original formula true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.CraigInterpolation.forgetting_semantics.{w} {α : Type w} (p : α)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) (v : α → Bool) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v (Lemmatheca.Entry.CraigInterpolation.forgetAtom p A) = true ↔
    ∃ b, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval (Function.update v p b) A = true
